transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, dear, I've been having trouble going to the toilet. It's been a bit of a bother lately.
When did you first notice it?
Oh, it's been going on a while now. I'm not too sure exactly when it started.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
I suppose I haven't been drinking as much as I used to. I cut back so I don't have to get up in the night.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
The stools come out hard, like little pellets. And I have to strain quite a bit, which is uncomfortable.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's down in my lower tummy, and it feels all bloated. It doesn't really spread anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
Oh, I couldn't really put a number on it. It's uncomfortable, but not terrible.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's not there all the time. It sort of comes and goes, mostly when I try to go.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, nothing else really. I haven't seen any blood or anything black in the stools, and I haven't been sick.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I do see the doctor. I've got arthritis in my back and knees, and I have an irregular heartbeat.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
Well, I take a few tablets for my heart and my bones, and some painkillers. I can't remember the names of them all, dear.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, not that I know of, dear. I've never had a reaction to anything.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Well, I still manage around the house, though the bloating and straining do slow me down a bit. My son helps out with most things anyway.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I suppose I do worry a bit. I'd like something to get things moving, and I hope it isn't anything serious, like cancer.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
